rubrics_metrics.name: FAI standards to judge space flight records
rubrics_metrics.description: Agreement reached by U.S. and Soviet delegates (to be presented to the Federation Aeronautique Internationale) setting rules for recognizing space flight records.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Under the proposal: competing flights must reach [the defined space boundary] to qualify as space flights (text shows 'must reach GQ\MDLES TO’QUALIFY AS SPACE FLIGHTS' — i.e., the international Kármán line/defined boundary). For manned rocket vehicles only, records to be recognized include duration, altitude and weight. New records must exceed previous world records by at least 10 percent in order to be recognized. A proposal to permit FAI observers to watch space shots was deferred.
